touches.text: Transport: as fast as we can make it, settled by measuring on this box, not by choosing. Inside a Linux box the bus is our own small broker on Unix sockets, routing by name (measured 50 µs a round trip, against 110 for Postgres NOTIFY and 250 for NATS). Between boxes, and on Windows (Python there has no AF_UNIX), it is TCP, speaking TLS with pinned certificate fingerprints checked both ways; cairn install makes each box's certificate. WHY TLS: no tunnel, nothing extra to set up.
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
